nodes.name: The Agent Loop
nodes.story: Before any product: the idea that an autonomous agent could live in a loop — read code, plan, edit, run, iterate. It first became real projects in spring 2024.

nodes.name: OpenHands
nodes.story: The older wave: an autonomous software-engineering agent that pre-dates Claude Code by eleven months. Born OpenDevin, renamed OpenHands in mid-2024.

drift.note: the idea grows a platform: plugins, SDK, cloud sandboxes
model-agnostic from the start

nodes.name: Cline
nodes.story: Started life inside the IDE as 'Claude Dev' — then dropped the Claude name to become Cline, a model-agnostic agent for VS Code and JetBrains.

drift.note: one model's sidekick becomes a model-agnostic IDE agent
shorter human-in-the-loop cycles inside the editor

nodes.name: Goose
nodes.story: Block's extensible open-source agent: 'beyond code suggestions'. The same loop, rebuilt around an extension system.

drift.note: extensions become the point — the loop is a substrate
autonomy traded for composability

nodes.name: Claude Code
nodes.story: The idea becomes a product. Anthropic's terminal harness crystallized the agent loop — research preview Feb 2025, then GA with the Agent SDK. The ancestral tool every later one is measured against.

drift.note: the loop becomes a terminal ritual — plan, edit, run, repeat
later opened up programmatically via the Agent SDK

nodes.name: Claude Agent SDK
nodes.story: Anthropic opens the harness to programmers: the agent loop as a library instead of a terminal ritual.

drift.note: the loop becomes a library — programmatic, not a ritual
no terminal needed; it lives inside your program

nodes.name: Codex CLI
nodes.story: OpenAI's answer, born weeks after Claude Code's preview: a lightweight Rust coding agent for the terminal, local-first.

drift.note: same shape, different soul: Rust, local-first, OpenAI's own models

nodes.name: Gemini CLI
nodes.story: Google's open-source take on the same loop: terminal agent, Apache-2.0, Gemini models, extension points.

drift.note: the loop opens up: extensions where Claude Code had MCP

nodes.name: OpenCode
nodes.story: The client-driven terminal agent: any model, any provider, runs on your laptop. Started under the SST org.

drift.note: the model becomes a choice, not an identity
a TUI you can run on your own machine

nodes.name: OpenClaw
nodes.story: The wildest drift: @steipete wrapped Claude Code as a backend and exposed it over WhatsApp, Telegram and friends. Five names in ten weeks — Warelay, Clawdis, Clawdbot, Moltbot, OpenClaw — and it became the most-starred node in the family.

drift.note: the harness leaves the terminal — it lives in your chats
Claude, Pi, Codex, OpenCode… any agent as a pluggable backend
it no longer codes for you; it orchestrates agents that do

nodes.name: DeepSeek Harness
nodes.story: DeepSeek's own harness — 'everything is a plugin', built on Cordis. Brand-new, developer preview, and it is the harness behind the very interface you are looking at right now.

drift.note: plugin-native via Cordis — the architecture IS the plugin system
a gateway-style harness, not just a coding loop
the loop generalizes beyond code

edges.note: first wave — the idea becomes a real project
the idea moves into the IDE
the idea becomes an extension platform
the idea crystallizes into the canonical harness
weeks after the preview went viral
Claude Code wrapped as a backend, exposed over messaging
the same loop, re-shelled: plugin-native on Cordis
